source_grounding.label: Mailchimp home page
observations: Markets itself as an AI-powered email marketing and automations platform.
Calls out email + SMS, analytics, automations, onboarding, and plan-tier feature differences.
Highlights popup forms, predictive segmentation, A/B testing, and 300+ integrations.

source_grounding.label: Mailchimp features page
observations: Lists product areas spanning email builder, landing pages, websites, content studio, segmentation, sign-up forms, surveys, tags, automations, reports, transactional email, webhooks, and integrations.
Shows visible surface families useful for parity scoping rather than internal implementation assumptions.

source_grounding.label: Mailchimp help center
observations: Help categories include Accounts, Audiences, Automation, Edit and Design, Emails, Integrations, Landing Pages, Reports, Templates, Transactional Email, and Websites.
This corroborates the core product surface families used in the surface map and teardown pack.
